chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, was asked about the skin of a pig being made into a bucket by which water is drawn, so he said:

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the one giving the ruling
key_terms.الْخِنْزِيرِ: pig; the animal whose skin is being discussed
key_terms.بِهِ: in it; referring to the mentioned use
key_terms.جِلْدِ: skin or hide used as a material
key_terms.دَلْوًا: a bucket used to draw water
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to use pig skin to make a bucket for drawing water?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام concerning the use of pig skin fashioned into a bucket for drawing water. The Imam عليه السلام states that there is no harm in this specific use.
